title: Overview
content:
# Overview

Run your own social accounts from Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or the terminal. Connect the Zernio MCP server or install the CLI, then ask in plain language.

Connect Zernio to Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or your terminal, then post, reply and check results on 42 platforms by asking.

## MCP server

Add one URL to your assistant and sign in with your Zernio account.

- [Connect with MCP](/for-you/mcp): Setup for Claude, ChatGPT, Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and VS Code.
- [Things to ask](/for-you/prompts): Requests that work well, from scheduling to replying to DMs.
- [Post images and videos](/for-you/media): Get a file from your computer into a post.

## Zernio CLI

Post, read DMs and pull analytics from the command line.

- [Install and log in](/for-you/cli): Two commands, then schedule your first post.
- [Everyday commands](/for-you/cli#everyday-commands): Accounts, posts, inbox and analytics.
- [Troubleshooting](/for-you/troubleshooting): Sign-in errors and accounts that need reconnecting.

## What you can do once connected

- [Post and schedule](/for-you/prompts#post-and-schedule): Publish now, schedule for later or save drafts on several platforms at once.
- [Answer DMs and comments](/for-you/prompts#inbox): Read what came in, get a summary and reply without opening each app.
- [See what worked](/for-you/prompts#analytics): Ask which posts performed best and compare reach across platforms.
- [Every platform you use](/for-you/platforms): Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, X, YouTube and the rest of the 42 platforms Zernio connects.
- [Keep an eye on ads](/for-you/prompts#ads): Check spend and results, and pause what is not working.
- [Images and videos too](/for-you/media): Upload through a link and the assistant attaches the file to your post.
